subject: Sandbox credits request: stepped 30h latency load test
messages:
From: Alexandra King <aking@velox-ai.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 24 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox credits for stepped 30-hour latency load test

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to run a stepped load run across our latency-sensitive endpoints to validate tail latency under realistic burst conditions. The plan is a 30-hour window starting Feb 2nd (PST) with three ramp phases: 2k RPS -> 6k RPS -> 12k RPS, each held for 8–10 hours. We expect ~350k total inference calls and roughly 1.1M tokens processed.

Can Redwood provide a temporary sandbox credit uplift and a short SLA exemption for this pre-prod POC? We can provide the test plan and preflight logs (attached). Also happy to sign an MOU if needed.

Attached: velox-stepped-load-plan.pdf

Thanks,
Alexandra King
VP Product
Velox AI

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 24 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox credits for stepped 30-hour latency load test

Thanks for the details, Alexandra — this looks well scoped. Quick clarifying questions before I route for approval:

- Do you need token-based credits or call-count credits? (we can do either; token credits usually map more closely to cost)
- Are you running across us-west + us-east, or also eu-west for this run?
- Do you need reserved concurrency during the window (we can pin a small Dedicated slice for the 30h if you prefer predictable tail latency)

I'll loop in Jonas (capacity/ops) and Marissa (pilot credits) — if we can confirm the numbers I can request a temporary sandbox top-up and a one-off SLA note. We typically approve these for customers moving to Dedicated, and your account health looks good.

Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Marissa / Jonas — forwarding a request from Velox AI. They want a token-style sandbox refill for a 30h stepped load on Feb 2nd (us-west + us-east). Numbers: request ~1.2M tokens; expect heavy tail sensitivity around 95–99th pct.

Proposal from my side: grant a 1.5M token sandbox uplift (safety margin), with the following conditions:
- Time-boxed window (Feb 2 00:00 PST to Feb 3 06:00 PST)

Marissa: does finance need an approval code or do you want me to create an internal PO for the uplift?

Thanks — Sergio
